mapper.sql: id, name, money, total, last_total, coupon_start_time, coupon_end_time, use_start_time, use_end_time, type, cate_key, min_money, create_time, update_time, status
mapper.select:
SELECT t1.id, t1.name, t1.money, t1.total, t1.last_total, t1.coupon_start_time, t1.coupon_end_time, t1.use_start_time, t1.use_end_time, t1.type, t1.cate_key, t1.min_money, t1.create_time, t1.update_time, t1.status, (SELECT MAX(u.id) FROM shop_product_coupon_user u WHERE u.cid = t1.id AND u.uid = #{userId}) AS coupon_user_id, CASE WHEN (SELECT MAX(u.id) FROM shop_product_coupon_user u WHERE u.cid = t1.id AND u.uid = #{userId}) IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS received, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(p.product_name ORDER BY p.id SEPARATOR '、') FROM shop_product p WHERE FIND_IN_SET(p.id, t1.cate_key)) AS product_names, (SELECT SUBSTRING_INDEX(GROUP_CONCAT(p.image ORDER BY p.id SEPARATOR ','), ',', 1) FROM shop_product p WHERE FIND_IN_SET(p.id, t1.cate_key)) AS product_image FROM shop_product_coupon t1 WHERE t1.status = 0 AND t1.type = 1 AND (t1.coupon_start_time IS NULL OR t1.coupon_start_time <= #{now}) AND (t1.coupon_end_time IS NULL OR t1.coupon_end_time >= #{now}) AND (t1.use_end_time IS NULL OR t1.use_end_time >= #{now})
AND t1.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{dto.name}, '%')
